title: Indian Young Lawyers Association v. State of Kerala (Sabarimala Case)

content.caseIdentity: Indian Young Lawyers Association v. State of Kerala (Sabarimala Case), (2018) 10 SCC 1
content.holding: Struck down exclusion of women aged 10–50 from Sabarimala temple; held practice was not essential to Hinduism and violated Articles 14, 15, and 21.
content.relevance: Gender equality and constitutional morality over exclusionary customs.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 373 of 2006; 2018 INSC 889; (2018) 10 SCC 1.
